subject: Supply chain evidence orchestration: BridgeWorks SIG + SOC 2 artifacts
messages:
From: Kylie Ramirez <kylie@bridgeworks.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bridgeworks.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: consolidated SIG/SOC2 scoping + subprocessor roster

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking this — BridgeWorks is starting a procurement review and we need a consolidated package covering SIG Lite answers and SOC 2 artifacts scoped to our integration. Can you confirm whether you can provide: 

- A redacted SIG Lite response (call out any HIGH/CRITICAL gaps)
- A current subprocessor roster with geographical residency and purpose of processing
- Proof of KMS ownership / key custody flow for customer data (notes or diagram is fine)
- SOC 2 artifact index (which exhibits we can expect: SOC report, SOC controls mapping, pen-test summary)
- Any additional supply-chain provenance notes (third-party model/weights origins, quantization provider names if used)

Target timeline: we need a first-pass package by EOD Wednesday, 2027-06-02 to keep our procurement sprint on track. If we need an NDA/ordering paperwork first, flag it.

Appreciate a short plan of what you’ll deliver and an ETA.

—Kylie
BridgeWorks (Security)
---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kylie Ramirez <kylie@bridgeworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated SIG/SOC2 scoping + subprocessor roster

Kylie — thanks for the clear list. We can get a scoped package together by your deadline. High-level plan: 

1) Today/Tomorrow: assemble redacted SIG Lite answers and export subprocessor roster (we’ll redact contact emails). Attached is an initial roster draft (columns: vendor, function, residency, data access level).
2) Monday: SOC 2 artifact index (we’ll include the latest SOC report summary and mapping table).
3) Tuesday morning: KMS/key custody diagram and short provenance note on external model components.
4) EOD Wednesday: consolidated zip with redacted SIG, SOC2 index, roster, and two short notes (KMS flow + third-party provenance).

We may need a quick DocuSign NDA for delivered artifacts marked confidential — is that a blocker for you? If yes, send procurement contact and we’ll push NDA to signature today.

Attaching: subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx (redacted stub)

Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
attachments: subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx (excel, 54KB)
---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-31T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated SIG/SOC2 scoping + subprocessor roster

Ben — looping in a suggested split of responsibilities so we hit EOD Wed reliably: 

- Marissa: prepare redacted SIG Lite PDF (remove assertive PII, call out any control exceptions). Deliverable: sig-lite-draft-redacted.pdf by Monday EOD.
- Jonas: collect KMS proof artifacts (KMS owner, key creation/rotation policy, recent rotation event log sample). Note: provide anonymized log entries only.
- Laura: preliminary SOC 2 index and list of exhibits we can release under NDA. I’ll coordinate with compliance to mark anything that requires an NDA.
- Ben: coordinate final packaging and liaison with BridgeWorks security for questions.

Checklist for delivery to BridgeWorks: 
- Redacted SIG Lite PDF (with summary of gaps)
- Subprocessor roster (redacted)
- SOC2 index (what we can share) + how to request the full report under NDA
- KMS flow + short provenance note re: model asset suppliers

Also: confirm whether we should include the quantization vendor (we use Q-Optics for our compression pipeline) — that will need residency information.

Marissa Cole
Director, Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
---
From: Kylie Ramirez <kylie@bridgeworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bridgeworks.com, procurement@bridgeworks.com
Date: 2027-06-02T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated SIG/SOC2 scoping + subprocessor roster

Ben / team — thanks, that plan works. A few quick clarifications before you package: 

- NDA: procurement will sign the BridgeWorks master confidentiality agreement; please send the DocuSign link. We can accept redacted artifacts prior to signature, but full SOC 2 exhibits will require the signed NDA.
- KMS proof: instead of full logs, a sanitized rotation log (timestamps + key IDs) and a short note on residency (where HSM/KMS is located) is fine.
- Quantization vendor: please include Q-Optics with residency and whether they have access to raw training data (yes/no).
- One extra ask: any notes on ephemeral key usage for prefix/KV cache eviction (we audit transient key use). If you can include a one-paragraph statement on how ephemeral keys are provisioned/rotated, that will close our review faster.

If you can send the DocuSign NDA link this afternoon and deliver the redacted bundle by EOD, we’ll schedule a 30-min walkthrough on Thursday morning.

Thanks — Kylie
BridgeWorks (Security)
attachments: none
